samples.xml_description:
<module id="alu">
    <description>An arithmetic logic unit (ALU) for performing arithmetic and logical operations based on the aluc control signal.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">A 32-bit input operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">A 32-bit input operand.</input>
        <input id="aluc" width_description="[5:0]">A 6-bit control signal for selecting the operation to be performed.</input>
        <output id="r" width_description="[31:0]">A 32-bit output representing the result of the operation.</output>
        <output id="zero" width_description="[0:0]">A 1-bit output indicating whether the result is zero.</output>
        <output id="carry" width_description="[0:0]">A 1-bit output indicating whether a carry occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="negative" width_description="[0:0]">A 1-bit output indicating whether the result is negative.</output>
        <output id="overflow" width_description="[0:0]">A 1-bit output indicating whether an overflow occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="flag" width_description="[0:0]">A 1-bit output representing a general flag, which is set based on specific operations (SLT and SLTU).</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <param id="ADD" value="6'b100000">Addition operation.</param>
        <param id="ADDU" value="6'b100001">Unsigned addition operation.</param>
        <param id="SUB" value="6'b100010">Subtraction operation.</param>
        <param id="SUBU" value="6'b100011">Unsigned subtraction operation.</param>
        <param id="AND" value="6'b100100">Bitwise AND operation.</param>
        <param id="OR" value="6'b100101">Bitwise OR operation.</param>
        <param id="XOR" value="6'b100110">Bitwise XOR operation.</param>
        <param id="NOR" value="6'b100111">Bitwise NOR operation.</param>
        <param id="SLT" value="6'b101010">Set less than operation.</param>
        <param id="SLTU" value="6'b101011">Unsigned set less than operation.</param>
        <param id="SLL" value="6'b000000">Logical left shift operation.</param>
        <param id="SRL" value="6'b000010">Logical right shift operation.</param>
        <param id="SRA" value="6'b000011">Arithmetic right shift operation.</param>
        <param id="SLLV" value="6'b000100">Variable left shift operation.</param>
        <param id="SRLV" value="6'b000110">Variable right shift operation.</param>
        <param id="SRAV" value="6'b000111">Variable arithmetic right shift operation.</param>
        <param id="LUI" value="6'b001111">Load upper immediate operation.</param>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="signed_a" width_description="[31:0]">Signed version of input operand a.</assign>
        <assign id="signed_b" width_description="[31:0]">Signed version of input operand b.</assign>
        <reg id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Register to store the result of the operation.</reg>
        <always_comb>
            // Default values
            res <= {32{1'bz}};
            
            // Case statement to select the appropriate operation based on aluc
            case(aluc)
                ADD: res <= signed_a + signed_b;
                ADDU: res <= a + b;
                SUB: res <= signed_a - signed_b;
                SUBU: res <= a - b;
                AND: res <= a & b;
                OR: res <= a | b;
                XOR: res <= a ^ b;
                NOR: res <= ~(a | b);
                SLT: res <= (signed_a < signed_b) ? 1 : 0;
                SLTU: res <= (a < b) ? 1 : 0;
                SLL: res <= b << a[4:0];
                SRL: res <= b >> a[4:0];
                SRA: res <= signed_b >>> a[4:0];
                SLLV: res <= b << a[4:0];
                SRLV: res <= b >> a[4:0];
                SRAV: res <= signed_b >>> a[4:0];
                LUI: res <= {a[15:0], 16'h0};
                default: res <= {32{1'bz}};
            endcase
        end
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Combinational logic for ALU operations.</implementation>
</module>
